message.rule: time is the same for every island
message.why: so the sun rises and sets for everyone together

message.rule: the weather is the same for every island
the game rules are the same for everyone
message.why: every island plays the same game

message.rule: a wish can't make a rule for the whole world
message.why: it would change every other island too

message.rule: recipes and drops are the same for everyone
message.why: that is what makes things rare and worth finding

message.rule: a wish stays on your own island
message.why: every island belongs to the player who lives there

_notes: What Scarcity Isle denies (time, weather, game rules and difficulty, world-wide datapacks and standing rules, recipes and drops, other players' bases, outside your own base, the Nether and the End) and the standing rules it ALLOWS (scoped to his own island or his pets). Schema: the core's WorldRules.parse. The wish bank: 10 to start, +1 every 30 minutes of real time, capped at 10, 1 a wish; a world with no wish_bank rule has no bank. The clamp: a power on him at most 300 s and never forever, a stack of each item and 3 kinds a wish, 5 XP levels a wish; shortened or shrunk and said, never refused.
